summary: Crown PropTech Acquisitions (SPAC) filed an 8-K on May 20, 2026, to disclose Amendment No. 2 to its business combination agreement with Mkango Rare Earths Limited and related parties. The amendment adjusts the Exchange Ratio, share issuances prior to closing, and adds a debt-to-equity exchange by Mkango as a closing condition. No specific price per share, premium, or deal values were stated. The SPAC’s board has not issued a new recommendation in this filing. Structural details include the involvement of a BVI company and a Canadian parent. A registration rights and lock-up agreement is expected at closing. The risk-arb angle centers on the completion of this rare earths de-SPAC transaction amid ongoing amendments.
